items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: It actually comes off sounding a little like Edward Elgar... I listen to — right now I’m delving into Sir Edward Elgar right now

ctx.x: Yeah. It actually comes off sounding a little like Edward Elgar, the first movement.
Wow. Do you get to play that at all anymore?
